title: 2-D Standard Deviation
text: 计算输入或输入序列的标准差，输入 5 路、输出 2 路；按 {Reset port} 指定重置事件；{Running standard deviation} 指定跟踪运行标准差、{Find the standard deviation value over} 指定沿其计算标准差的维度 Entire、{Dimension} 指定自定义维度、{Enable ROI processing} 指定计算特定区域内的标准差、{ROI type} 指定 ROI 类型、{ROI portion to process} 指定计算标准差的 ROI 部分、{Output} 指定计算单个 ROI 或整个 ROI 的标准差 Individual statistics for each、{Output flag indicating if ROI is within image bounds} 启用 Flag 端口、{Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 输入数组 vector | matrix | N-D - array

ports.name: ROI
ports.summary: 感兴趣区域 four-element vector | m -by-4 matrix | M -by- N matrix

ports.name: Label
ports.summary: 标签矩阵 matrix of nonnegative integers

ports.name: Label Numbers
ports.summary: ROI 的标签值 M -element vector

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 计算得到的输出标准差 scalar | vector | matrix | N-D -array

params.name: Running standard deviation
params.values: 跟踪运行标准差 off (default) | on

params.name: Reset port
params.values: 重置事件 None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Find the standard deviation value over
params.values: 沿其计算标准差的维度 Entire input (default) | Each row | Each column | Specified dimension

params.name: Enable ROI processing
params.values: 计算特定区域内的标准差 off (default) | on

params.name: ROI type
params.values: ROI 类型 Rectangles (default) | Lines | Label matrix | Binary mask

params.name: ROI portion to process
params.values: 计算标准差的 ROI 部分 Entire ROI (default) | ROI perimeter

params.name: Output
params.values: 计算单个 ROI 或整个 ROI 的标准差 Individual statistics for each ROI (default) | Single statistic for all ROIs

params.name: Output flag indicating if ROI is within image bounds
params.values: 启用 Flag 端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
